Plone sprint report

The sprint took place in the old town hall and brought together twenty developers from seven countries. They worked on the new theming story and on many small bug fixes for several days.

Maurits van Rees is a long time contributor. He works for Zest Software and has fixed many bugs in the release process during this sprint, which made the final release possible.

At the end of the week the group presented the results to the local community, who asked many questions about the roadmap and the next steps for the project.

About the author: Jane Doe leads the Plone team at Acme Corporation.
